summary: Manages the execution environment, runtime parameters, configuration policies, observers, and result structures for AI model interactions, text/object generation, streaming, and embeddings.
responsibilities: Manage execution context and model context for AI operations.
Register global retry observers for execution monitoring.
Define parameters and policies for tool loops, text generation, streaming, object generation, and embedding.
Represent results, metadata, streaming events, and token usage statistics for AI executions.
relationships: Execution parameter configurations and execution contexts support AI model invocation and execution tracking.
Execution results capture outputs, metadata, and token usage from AI generation operations.
design_decisions: Defines execution contexts, observation mechanisms, parameters for text, stream, object generation and embedding, and structured results for AI operations.
